snippet_primary:
> "Stripe supports all major debit and credit cards, including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and more. This also includes a wide range of local and alternative payment methods, such as:
> * Digital wallets: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, Samsung Pay, Cash App Pay, Alipay, WeChat Pay
> * Bank redirects / transfers: iDEAL, Bancontact, EPS, Przelewy24, BLIK, FPX, Pay by Bank, Multibanco, MB WAY, OXXO, Konbini
> * Real-time payments: Pix, Swish, PayNow, PromptPay, PayTo
> * Mobile payments: TWINT, Kakao Pay, Naver Pay, PAYCO, MobilePay, Satispay, Revolut Pay
> * Buy Now, Pay Later: Afterpay / Clearpay, Klarna, Affirm, Alma, Zip, Billie"
subject_exact: Métodos de pago soportados por Stripe según el help center: tarjetas (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), wallets digitales (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, Samsung Pay, Cash App Pay, Alipay, WeChat Pay), redirects bancarios (iDEAL, Bancontact, EPS, Przelewy24, BLIK, FPX, Multibanco, OXXO, Konbini y más), pagos en tiempo real (Pix, Swish, PayNow, PromptPay, PayTo), pagos móviles (TWINT, Kakao Pay, Naver Pay, PAYCO, MobilePay, Satispay, Revolut Pay) y BNPL (Afterpay/Clearpay, Klarna, Affirm, Alma, Zip, Billie)
metric_value_raw: all major debit and credit cards plus digital wallets, bank redirects, real-time payments, mobile payments and Buy Now Pay Later
local_qualifiers: a wide range of local and alternative payment methods
parser_notes: Rails de pago nombrados incluidos en platforms de forma representativa (redes de tarjeta, wallets principales y rails citados en el corpus); la lista completa de métodos queda verbatim en snippet_primary.
